title: Orchestrator State File v1
description: Schema for the orchestrator workflow state file stored at .agentic-workflow/runs/<backlog>/orchestrator.json. This file is the single source of truth for a workflow session: it tracks session metadata, pricing, phase progress, epic/story status, and an append-only dispatch log.

version.description: Schema version. Always 1 for this schema. Increment when breaking changes are introduced.

session.description: Metadata about the current workflow session.

backlog.description: GitHub issue number of the backlog item being executed (e.g. 150).

mode.description: Execution mode: 'autonomous' skips human-interactive steps; 'interactive' waits for PR approvals and human input.

orchestrator_model.description: Model variant the orchestrator agent is running on (e.g. 'opus', 'sonnet'). Used for cost estimation of orchestrator overhead rows in telemetry.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the orchestrator session began. Used by 'state.sh lifecycle-duration' to compute total elapsed time.

lifecycle_duration_ms.description: Computed by 'state.sh lifecycle-duration': milliseconds from session.started_at to the time the command ran. Null until computed.

start_wall_clock.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp captured at session start for wall-clock computation. Used by 'state.sh overhead' to compute orchestrator overhead (wall-clock minus critical path).

repo.description: GitHub repository in 'owner/name' format (e.g. 'carlosboeing/agentic-sdlc-workflow'). Captured from 'gh repo view' at init time.

git_main_sha.description: Short SHA of the git HEAD at session start. Useful for identifying the baseline commit when diagnosing branch contamination.

overhead.description: Computed orchestrator overhead: wall-clock time minus the critical path of sub-agent dispatches. Represents time spent on branch operations, board management, merges, and other orchestrator work outside of sub-agent dispatches.

duration_ms.description: Orchestrator overhead duration in milliseconds. Computed by 'state.sh overhead' as max(0, total_wall_clock_ms - critical_path_ms). Null until computed. Critical path groups dispatches by started_at and sums max(duration_ms) per parallel wave.

estimated_cost.description: Estimated cost of orchestrator overhead in USD. Always null — orchestrator token usage is not directly measurable from the Agent tool result. Included for schema completeness.

pricing.description: Live pricing data fetched from Anthropic's pricing page at session start via 'scripts/fetch-pricing.sh'. Used by 'issue-telemetry.sh' for cost estimation. Keys are model names; values contain per-million-token rates.

additionalProperties.description: Pricing for a single model variant.

input_per_mtok.description: Cost in USD per million input tokens.

output_per_mtok.description: Cost in USD per million output tokens.

phases.description: Tracks the status of each workflow phase. Keys are phase names: design, plan, build, review, retro.

epics.description: Map of epic slug to epic metadata. Keys are epic slugs (e.g. 'e01-script-extraction'). Populated by 'state.sh update --epic'. Used for cross-contamination detection (base_sha) and story telemetry aggregation.

dispatches.description: Append-only log of every agent dispatch in this workflow session. Each entry records the agent type, model, timing, token usage, and result. Used by 'compute-dispatches.py' for wall-clock, Gantt, and cost computation. Never modified — only appended.

phase.description: Status of a single workflow phase.

status.description: Current status of this phase. 'pending': not yet started. 'in_progress': actively running. 'complete': finished successfully. 'skipped': intentionally bypassed (e.g. design skipped when doc already exists).

pr.description: GitHub PR number associated with this phase (e.g. the design doc PR or plan PR). Optional.

telemetry.description: Telemetry data for this phase (duration_ms, tokens, tool_uses). Set by the orchestrator after the phase agent completes. Optional.

epic.description: Metadata for a single epic within the workflow session.

base_sha.description: Git SHA of the epic branch at the time story branches were created. Used to detect cross-contamination: if a story branch diverges from this SHA, its commits may contain unintended work from a sibling story.

stories.description: Map of story issue number (as string) to story metadata. Keys are GitHub issue numbers as strings (e.g. '157', '158').

story.description: Metadata and telemetry for a single story.

status.description: Current status of this story in the workflow lifecycle.

build.description: Telemetry from the builder agent dispatch for this story. Set automatically by 'state.sh update --dispatch' when agent contains 'builder'.

duration_ms.description: Builder agent wall-clock duration in milliseconds.

tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by the builder agent.

tool_uses.description: Number of tool calls made by the builder agent.

review.description: Telemetry from the reviewer agent dispatch for this story. Set automatically by 'state.sh update --dispatch' when agent contains 'reviewer'.

duration_ms.description: Reviewer agent wall-clock duration in milliseconds.

tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by the reviewer agent.

tool_uses.description: Number of tool calls made by the reviewer agent.

dispatch.description: A single agent dispatch record. Appended by 'state.sh update --dispatch'. Never modified after creation.

id.description: Sequential dispatch ID. Assigned as len(dispatches) + 1 at the time of append.

model.description: Model variant used for this dispatch (e.g. 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku').

issue.description: GitHub issue number associated with this dispatch. Null for non-story dispatches (design, plan, retro). When set and matching a story in epics.*.stories, automatically updates that story's build or review telemetry.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this dispatch began. Dispatches with the same started_at are treated as a parallel wave by 'compute-dispatches.py' for wall-clock computation.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this dispatch completed. Computed as started_at + duration_ms.

duration_ms.description: Total agent wall-clock duration in milliseconds as reported by the Agent tool result.

tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by this dispatch (input + output combined).

tool_uses.description: Number of tool calls made during this dispatch.
